create_adsorbate_slab_config: create an AdsorbateSlabConfig to generate adsorbate-catalyst systems for a given slab and adsorbate with random or heuristic placement modes
get_binding_sites: get binding sites on a slab surface using Delaunay triangulation or pymatgen AdsorbateSiteFinder for adsorbate placement
place_adsorbate_on_site: place an adsorbate molecule at a specific binding site on a slab with rotation and overlap avoidance
check_atomic_overlap: check if there is atomic overlap between surface atoms and adsorbate atoms using covalent radii distance checks
get_interstitial_distances: get the interstitial distances between all surface-adsorbate atom pairs to verify no covalent radius overlap exists
